主要内容: J. Willard Marriott, Jr., Executive Chairman and Chairman of the Board of Marriott International (NASDAQ: MAR), has been chosen by Ernst & Young to receive the 2016 EY Entrepreneur of the Year® Award in the Real Estate, Hospitality and Construction category and the U.S. Entrepreneur of the Year Overall Award. The award recognizes his leadership in pursuing business excellence, innovation, fiscal growth, and community service. Marriott International, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAR) is the world's largest hotel company with nearly 6,000 properties in 120 countries and territories. The company operates and franchises hotels and licenses vacation ownership resorts, with 30 leading brands including The Ritz-Carlton® and Marriott Hotels®. The award highlights Marriott's commitment to excellence and its role in the hospitality industry.
